info.name: Enterprise API - Authentication & Profile Collection
info.description:
# Enterprise API - Complete Authentication & User Profile Specification

This collection contains all endpoints, contracts, validation constraints, and examples for **Client Authentication**, **Admin Authentication**, **Provider Authentication**, **Admin Provider Management**, and **Account Profile/Security**.

---

## Architectural Principles for Frontend Engineers & AI Code Generators

### 1. Unified Response Envelope (`ApiResponse<T>`)
Every single API response (success or failure) adheres to the identical JSON schema:
```json
{
  "success": true | false,
  "statusCode": 200 | 201 | 400 | 401 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 429 | 500,
  "message": "Human-readable localized message (e.g. English, Arabic, Italian)",
  "errors": ["Array of specific validation error messages when failed"],
  "data": null | { ...payload },
  "traceId": "Correlation ID for backend logs"
}
```

### 2. Localization (`Accept-Language` Header)
- Supported culture codes: `en` (English - default), `ar` (Arabic), `it` (Italian).
- Pass `Accept-Language: ar` or `Accept-Language: it` in every request header to get fully localized API envelope messages and validation errors.

### 3. JWT Authentication & Bearer Tokens
- Access tokens are JWTs passed in header: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
- Expiry: 60 minutes (Development) / 15 minutes (Production).
- Refresh tokens are long-lived (7 days). Store securely (HttpOnly cookie or secure storage) and call `/refresh-token` automatically when `accessToken` expires.
- Keep tokens **per portal** (`client*`, `admin*`, `provider*`).

### 4. OTP Workflow (Passwordless for Clients)
- In **Development mode**, when an OTP is requested (Register, Login, Change Email, Reset Password), the response body contains a convenience property: `"developmentOtp": "123456"` so you can test registration and login automatically without accessing email inboxes or console logs!
- In **Production mode**, `developmentOtp` is `null` and the OTP code is dispatched via SMTP email.
- Default OTP expiry: **10 minutes**.
- Max verification attempts: **5 attempts** before invalidation.

### 5. Rate Limiting
- Authentication endpoints are strictly rate-limited to **10 requests per minute per IP** (`auth` policy).
- Exceeding the rate limit returns HTTP `429 Too Many Requests`.

### 6. Admin / Provider Account Lockout Policy
- 5 consecutive failed login attempts locks the account for **15 minutes**.

### 7. Providers (Subito sellers)
- Providers are created only by Admin via `/api/v1/admin/providers` (no public registration).
- Provider auth mirrors Admin password auth under `/api/v1/provider/auth`.

item.name: 1. Client Auth (/api/v1/client/auth)
item.description: Passwordless OTP authentication flow for end-user clients.

request.description:
### Client Registration
Initiates a new client account. Sends an OTP code to the provided email.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Valid email address format. Max length: `256` chars.
- `firstName` (string, **Required**): Non-empty string. Max length: `100` chars.
- `lastName` (string, **Required**): Non-empty string. Max length: `100` chars.

#### Response Behavior:
- Status `200 OK`: Returns OTP confirmation. In Development mode, `developmentOtp` provides the 6-digit OTP code directly.
- Status `409 Conflict`: If email is already registered.

response.name: 200 Success (Development Mode with OTP)
409 Conflict (Email Already Exists)
400 Bad Request (Validation Errors)
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "One or more validation errors occurred.",
  "errors": [
    "A valid email address is required.",
    "This field is required."
  ],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000003"
}

item.name: 1.2 Client Verify Registration (Submit OTP -> Get Tokens)

request.description:
### Verify Client Registration
Verifies the OTP sent during registration, confirms the email address, and issues initial JWT access and refresh tokens.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): The registered email address.
- `otp` (string, **Required**): The 6-digit verification code. (Constraints: string length between 4 and 10).

#### Response Behavior:
- Status `200 OK`: Returns `accessToken`, `accessTokenExpiresAtUtc`, `refreshToken`, and user identity.
- Status `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or expired verification code.

response.name: 200 Success (Tokens Issued)
401 Unauthorized (Invalid or Expired OTP)

request.description:
### Client Login Request (Passwordless)
Initiates a client login session by sending a single-use login OTP to the user's email.

#### Security / Anti-Enumeration:
If the account does not exist or is inactive, the endpoint still returns `200 OK` with a generic message ("If an account exists, a code was sent") to prevent user enumeration attacks.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Valid email format.

response.name: 200 Success (Development Mode with OTP)

item.name: 1.4 Client Verify Login (Submit OTP -> Get Tokens)

request.description:
### Verify Client Login
Verifies the login OTP code and returns authenticated session tokens.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Registered email.
- `otp` (string, **Required**): 6-digit code received via email.

#### Response:
- Returns `AuthResponseDto` with `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and user payload.

response.name: 200 Success (Logged In)
401 Unauthorized (Invalid / Expired Login Code)

request.description:
### Client Social / External Authentication
Authenticates a user using an OAuth2 / OpenID Connect ID token from an external identity provider.
If the user does not exist yet, the account is automatically created and email confirmed.

#### Supported Providers:
- `"Google"` (Google Identity Services JWT ID token)
- `"Facebook"` (Facebook Graph User Access Token)

#### Request Fields:
- `provider` (string, **Required**): Allowed values are `"Google"` or `"Facebook"` (case-insensitive).
- `idToken` (string, **Required**): Raw ID token string from the provider SDK. Max length: `8192` chars.

response.name: 200 Success (Social Login Authenticated)
400 Bad Request (Unsupported Provider)

request.description:
### Client Refresh Token (Rotation)
Exchanges an existing active refresh token for a fresh JWT access token and a **new rotated refresh token**.

#### Security Note (Token Rotation):
When a refresh token is used, the previous token is marked revoked and replaced with a newly generated one. If an expired or already-revoked token is presented, the request is rejected with `401 Unauthorized`.

#### Request Fields:
- `refreshToken` (string, **Required**): The refresh token string received on prior login/refresh.

response.name: 200 Success (Token Refreshed)
401 Unauthorized (Invalid or Revoked Token)

request.description:
### Client Logout / Revoke Token
Explicitly revokes an active refresh token, rendering it unusable for subsequent sessions.

#### Request Fields:
- `refreshToken` (string, **Required**): The refresh token to invalidate.

response.name: 200 Success (Token Revoked)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Token revoked successfully.",
  "errors": [],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000013"
}

item.name: 3. Admin Auth (/api/v1/admin/auth)
item.description: Password-based authentication, lockout protection, and credential recovery for Administrators.

request.description:
### Administrator Login
Authenticates an administrator using email and password.

#### Security Rules:
- **Default Dev Credentials**: `admin@enterprise.local` / `Admin@12345!`
- **Account Lockout**: 5 failed consecutive attempts locks the account for **15 minutes**.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Admin email address.
- `password` (string, **Required**): Plaintext password.

#### Response:
- Returns `AuthResponseDto` with Admin claims, roles, and permissions.

response.name: 200 Success (Admin Logged In)
401 Unauthorized (Invalid Credentials)
401 Unauthorized (Account Locked Out)

request.description:
### Admin Forgot Password
Initiates password recovery by sending a password reset OTP to the administrator's email.

#### Security Note:
Returns `200 OK` regardless of whether the email is found to guard against user enumeration.

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Valid email address.

response.name: 200 Success (Instructions Sent)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "If an account exists with this email, password reset instructions have been sent.",
  "errors": [],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000022"
}

item.name: 3.3 Admin Reset Password (Submit OTP + New Password)

request.description:
### Admin Reset Password
Consumes the password reset OTP and sets a new password on the admin account.

#### Password Policy Constraints (`newPassword`):
- Minimum length: **8 characters**
- At least 1 uppercase letter (`[A-Z]`)
- At least 1 lowercase letter (`[a-z]`)
- At least 1 numeric digit (`[0-9]`)
- At least 1 special character (`[^a-zA-Z0-9]` e.g. `!@#$%^&*`)

#### Request Fields:
- `email` (string, **Required**): Admin email.
- `otp` (string, **Required**): 6-digit code.
- `newPassword` (string, **Required**): Meets password complexity rules.

response.name: 200 Success (Password Reset)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Your password has been reset successfully. You may now sign in.",
  "errors": [],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000023"
}

response.name: 400 Bad Request (Weak Password)
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "One or more validation errors occurred.",
  "errors": [
    "Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.",
    "Password must contain at least one special character."
  ],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000024"
}

request.description:
### Admin Change Password
Allows an authenticated admin to change their password by supplying the old password and a new strong password.

#### Security:
Requires `Authorization: Bearer <adminAccessToken>`.

#### Request Fields:
- `currentPassword` (string, **Required**): Existing password.
- `newPassword` (string, **Required**): New strong password.

response.name: 200 Success (Password Changed)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Password changed successfully.",
  "errors": [],
  "data": null,
  "traceId": "0HNOGQC9211AB:00000025"
}

response.name: 401 Unauthorized (Incorrect Current Password)

request.description:
### Admin Refresh Token (Rotation)
Exchanges an existing admin refresh token for a fresh JWT and new rotated refresh token.

response.name: 200 Success (Refreshed)

request.description:
### Admin Logout / Revoke Token
Revokes the provided refresh token for the administrator session.

  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Token revoked successfully.",
